note: Gold tokens come from the planted patterns in gen_duckdb.py (see gold.json). An answer is scored correct when it contains all gold tokens. Cases target two scale axes: data size (traversal cost) and schema cardinality (12 transaction channels), the latter being where a bare LLM must guess which relationship/channel to follow and the ontology-driven middleware does not. A gold token may list alternatives separated by '|' — a channel is equally correctly named by its code or its human label. Each case carries a complexity tier: 'core' needs only Account+TRANSFER, 'schema_rich' needs channel knowledge (Channel label, USES_CHANNEL, or a channel/amount predicate).

cases.scenario: S5 fan-in / smurfing — graph traversal a vector RAG cannot do
cases.question: How many distinct accounts sent transfers into the account with account number 9000100?

cases.scenario: S1 one-hop — the flagged account's direct counterparties
cases.question: Which accounts did the account with account number 9000200 directly transfer money to? List the account numbers.

cases.scenario: S1 bounded multi-hop — reachable set within 3 transfer hops (naive unbounded path explodes)
cases.question: List every account reachable within 3 transfer hops from the account with account number 9000200, by account number.

cases.scenario: S5 laundering ring — cycle detection back to the start account
cases.question: Starting from the account with account number 9000001, is there a transfer cycle of length 3 that returns to it? Name the account numbers on the ring.
Is the account with account number 9000200 flagged, and what is its risk tier?

cases.scenario: S6 schema cardinality — pick the right channel out of 12 for a specific edge
cases.question: Over which channel did the account with account number 9000200 transfer money to account number 9000201?

cases.scenario: S6 channel-aware traversal — combine relationship choice with a risk predicate
cases.question: Which accounts received transfers from the account with account number 9000200 over a channel whose channel_risk is 5? List the account numbers.

cases.scenario: S6 ring + channel — the laundering cycle rides low-traceability rails
cases.question: List the distinct channels used by transfers among accounts 9000001, 9000002 and 9000003.

cases.scenario: S6 structuring — CTR-threshold evasion detected via amount + channel
cases.question: How many transfers into the account with account number 9000100 have an amount below 10000000?
